method: Manual inspection of rendered PNGs plus script assertions and actual source/base geometry sampling; not survey validation.

observations.finding: Central hard paving now visibly joins the actual roadway to the north stairs. The higher south body remains behind the north facade; nearby trees do not occupy the central passage.
Stair risers remain visible across the central entrance; paving meets the lowest step. Six portico columns and the door opening are retained.
A narrow central connector is visible, not an invented whole-plaza boundary. Existing courtyard and surrounding road layout remain.
At 390 x 844 the road, connector, lowest stair and doorway are visible together without the former foreground crown obstruction.
Basic library representation retains the north entrance and connector. The side camera is partly obstructed by an adjacent ordinary building, limiting full-field inspection.
Connector remains with buildings disabled and roads enabled, matching site road-layer ownership.
North entrance and paving remain visible at night with labels disabled; side-angle trees obscure some paving but are outside the central corridor.

limitations: Single photos do not establish the complete real plaza outline or surveyed grades.
Side camera is partially occluded; front and overhead cameras complement it.
The old and new library near GLB hashes match; forecourt is a permanent base object.
